run_dense_eval_hybrid: run the AdsorbML dense evaluation script with hybrid ML+DFT success rates for top-k configurations
run_dense_eval_ml_only: run the AdsorbML dense evaluation script with ML-only success rates using the --ml-success flag
run_dense_eval_custom_maxk: run the AdsorbML dense evaluation script with a custom maxk value for top-k retrieval
compute_hybrid_success: compute AdsorbML hybrid success rates at varying top-k values comparing ML+DFT energies to ground truth DFT
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML-only success rates where ML energies must be within 0.1 eV of DFT energy
is_successful: compute whether a predicted ML+DFT energy is within the success threshold of the ground truth DFT energy
get_dft_data: organize released DFT target mapping into a dictionary for evaluation lookup by system and config ID
get_dft_compute: calculate total DFT compute usage in SCF and ionic steps from the released compute counts file
filter_ml_data: filter ML data by setting missing systems or configurations to high energy values for failure case evaluation
